content: This medication is used in combination with other HIV medications to help control HIV infection. It works by reducing the amount of HIV in your body, which allows your immune system to function more effectively. However, it is important to note that this medication is not a cure for HIV infection. To minimize the risk of transmitting HIV to others, you should continue taking all HIV medications exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Additionally, use effective barrier methods, such as latex or polyurethane condoms or dental dams, during sexual activity as directed by your doctor. Avoid sharing personal items like needles, syringes, toothbrushes, or razors that may have come into contact with blood or other bodily fluids. Before using this medication, read the Patient Information Leaflet and Instructions for Use provided by your pharmacist. If you have any questions, consult your healthcare professional. This medication is administered as an injection under the skin, typically twice daily, as directed by your doctor. The injection should be given in the upper arm, thigh, or abdomen. Do not inject into the buttocks or near the elbow, knee, or groin. Before use, visually inspect the product for particles or discoloration. If either is present, do not use the liquid. Clean the injection site with rubbing alcohol before each dose. Rotate the injection site with each use to reduce the risk of skin injury. Avoid injecting into or near bumps from previous injections, moles, scars, bruises, tattoos, burn areas, or the belly button. To reduce bruising, do not rub the injection site after administering the medication. It is crucial to continue using this medication, along with other anti-HIV medications, exactly as prescribed by your doctor. For optimal effectiveness, take this medication at evenly spaced intervals. Common side effects include pain, redness, itching, bruising, hardened skin, or bumps at the injection site, which may last up to seven days. A runny nose may also occur. Remember that this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. As your immune system strengthens, it may begin to fight off infections you already had, potentially causing symptoms of those diseases to reappear. In some cases, an overactive immune response may occur, which can happen at any time, either shortly after starting HIV treatment or months later. Serious allergic reactions to this medication are rare. Before using this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other problems. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly needed. HIV treatment can reduce the risk of transmitting the infection to your baby, and this medication may be part of that treatment. It is unknown whether this medication passes into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase your risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This document does not contain all possible drug interactions. If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. While using this medication, laboratory and/or medical tests (such as liver function tests) should be performed regularly. Keep all medical and lab appointments. If you miss a dose, contact your doctor or pharmacist promptly to establish a new dosing schedule. Before mixing, store the dry powder and mixing solution at room temperature. Once mixed, store the medication in the refrigerator and use it within 24 hours. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
